games.name: Sorted by Christmas
games.description: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

games.name: All Haul the King
games.description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

games.name: Enchantalot
games.description: Strike and enchant weapons on a magic workbench. Each success makes them stronger and worth more - but the higher you climb, the riskier every blow. Send your gear out on quests, collect relics that build on each other, and watch the numbers spiral out of control.

games.name: Tiny Queendom: An Ant Terrarium
games.description: A living ant colony on your desktop. Build a glass terrarium of sand, water and plants, add one queen, and watch her family dig tunnels, forage, learn from danger and raise new queens on its own. Keep it in a small window in the corner of your screen while you work.

games.name: Sol Mates
games.description: Blast and laugh your way through space with up to 4 friends in this chaotic roguelike co-op. Every run is a new adventure so steer, shield, and work together to take on unpredictable challenges - or at least go out in style.

games.name: Wisps & Wares: A Spirit of the North Idler
games.description: Return to the enchanting world of Spirit of the North in a cozy shopkeeping idler. Send your Fox Guardian exploring, gather treasures, stock the Raccoon’s traveling shop, and journey across the Northern Isles in charming pixel art.

games.name: Mall Security
games.description: Co-op physics comedy for 1–4 mall guards. X-ray shoppers, yell orders into your mic, chase shoplifters and throw them in the cell. Every broken window goes on your report, so try not to get fired. Or switch sides in Thieves vs Guards PvP.

games.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator - First Short Circuit
games.description: Take your first steps in the electronics repair business! Enter your home garage, master the basics of diagnostics, use the multimeter, and solve your very first hardware crises. Fix basic devices, satisfy your clients, and face the ultimate test: your first short circuit!

games.name: MOONWRIGHT
games.description: A lunar mining sim where the time lag is part of the game. Age of a new Gold Rush started and you are one of the first prospectors on the Moon. Drive a rover, find and mine lunar ores and sell what you mined. Use money to upgrade rover and Moon base. Receive new missions and try your luck there.

games.name: Mop & Plot
games.description: Clock in, clean up, and watch your back: in this chaotic online social deduction game for up to 12 players, paint walls, scrub floors, and finish the job while hidden Saboteurs wreak havoc. Use proximity voice chat to spot the culprits and vote them out!

games.name: The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
games.description: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fish and out-fence your old captain to a legendary hoard.

games.name: Leaf to Sun
games.description: Autumn is ending, and the sun grows weaker by the day. Blow fallen leaves into the bonfire to grow the fire, and power up your wind and flames with the skill tree. Before long, the journey heads to space. A relaxing pixel-art incremental game.

games.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
games.description: Hit the road and set up shop, solo or with friends! Take your caravan wherever demand leads, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the hearts, minds, and wallets of a vast, dynamic world!

games.name: Kibble Rescue
games.description: A cozy first-person cleanup game. The shop cats tore open a giant bag of pet food and buried Happy Paws Pet Shop under a million kibbles. Scoop it up, pack it into crates, wrap and ship the boxes, buy bigger tools, and put every product back on its shelf before closing time.

games.name: STICKMAN DESKTOP MALWARS
games.description: A physics stickman brawler on a living computer desktop. The taskbar is the floor, windows are platforms and every app opens a new arena. Brawl as eight ragdoll fighters, each with their own attacks, or be the giant mouse cursor: charge a RAM, run VirusGuard on them and open a black hole.

games.name: Living With Dad - Family Party
games.description: Take on the Championn’Appart challenge with Dad’s Girls in this colourful party game! Who will take the top spot on the podium?

games.name: Sitry & Chami Desktop Pet
games.description: Meet Sitry & Chami, your adorable hand-painted gouache desktop companions! Watch them climb active windows, dangle their legs from title bars, play bongo drums to your keyboard typing, and hilariously prank your screen with paint splatters and squeaky hammers.

games.name: Clara Wraiths 3
games.description: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

games.name: Charmosaic
games.description: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

games.name: Holy Nest
games.description: Deep underground, where light has never been, live blind beetles. They know the world by sound, and by sound they know their god. A god game and colony sim with indirect control: the swarms live on their own, and you guide them with sound, touch and miracles. Your deeds decide what god you are.

games.name: Dummy Works
games.description: Unleash chaos on test dummies in this physics sandbox, but not all is as it seems.

games.name: Impferno
games.description: An online co-op game for up to 8 players. Explore the Circles of Hell in search of monsters and collect their souls before time runs out. Work and fight together to survive. But never forget: trust has no place among demons!

games.name: Pack it! Part-Time Master
games.description: Scan! Stack! The ultimate basket-packing challenge! Become a part-time master!

games.name: My Crazy Stupid Pong Life
games.description: One summer, one paddle, and a megacorp that wants every court in the city... Life gets weird when every problem is settled over Ping Pong.

games.name: One Million Chips
games.description: A short first-person incremental game set in a flooded casino. Scoop, rake, shovel and vacuum one million in chips into the giant funnel, spend your tips at Valeria's counter, and clear every last chip from the Casino Fortuna.

games.name: Deadlines
games.description: A multiplayer melee combat game where you and your coworkers are trapped in a sprawling office building with an impossible deadline. Work together to survive, form alliances to improve your odds, or turn on your coworkers before they turn on you.

games.name: Planet Chess
games.description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

games.name: Knock Twice
games.description: Queens, 1974. Something in Garland Court knocks twice, and it can only come in if you answer. It wears your neighbours' voices. Check the peephole, count the shadows, keep the chain on. Five apartments, three years of the building's past, thirty-two endings.

games.name: This is not just a farm
games.description: This Is Not Just a Farm is an idle farming simulator with horror elements where you can make progress while doing other things on your computer.

games.name: HIGH HORNS
games.description: CLIMB TO CONQUER! Physics-based co-op VR climbing

games.name: Logisticats
games.description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

games.name: Deep Clean
games.description: A co-op horror comedy for up to 4 players. You're a crew of space janitors: scrub stations after "incidents" and find out what roams the halls and how to survive it. There are no instructions: try everything, log your discoveries in the glossary and piece together the truth.

games.name: Fast Food Together
games.description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

games.name: Beakwood
games.description: As a stork, deliver packages across Beakwood, a cozy town that changes with every season, while a gang of jealous, gadget-crazed hawks glide, hover and rocket in to sabotage your route.

games.name: Tempo Derby
games.description: Tempo Derby is a timing-driven horse-racing roguelike. Hit the sweet spot, build powerful relic combinations and race through a 15-stage campaign. Unlock new horses, fuse legendary relics and outpace five bosses on your way to the championship.

games.name: Baggage Bedlam
games.description: Baggage Bedlam is a fast paced multiplayer party game where friends compete to route luggage through chaotic airport conveyor belts. Flip switches, grab power ups, dodge floor hazards, and sabotage your friends as you race to deliver bags to the right destinations!

games.name: Tidy Up: Midnight Cleaner Simulator
games.description: Clean up spooky buildings at night as a caretaker. Sort the trash into the correct categories. Will you survive the nights?

games.name: Dungeon Dealer
games.description: Heroes bleed. You profit. Send squads into deadly dungeons, crack open chests of glowing loot and sell every find at the perfect moment. Arm your best heroes, conquer it all, then retire rich and start a bigger era in this pixel-art incremental game.

games.name: Tidy Up the Grocery Warehouse
games.description: One partner snapped, and Ultra Fresh Food needs your help. About 3,000 products hit the floor. Restore order to the grocery warehouse with handy abilities or your own two hands, then pick and pack orders until the shelves are empty.

games.name: Raisin Universe
games.description: Your stream chat is the controller. Viewers play Minefield, Sudoku, Crossword, Marble Race and more by typing in Twitch or TikTok chat. Play 16 minigames on their own, or run a full board game with three boards.

games.name: Tiny Desktop Terrarium
games.description: Tiny Desktop Terrarium is a glass world that lives on your desktop. You build it however you want, add creatures and inhabitants then watch it grow and flourish while you use your computer and go about your day. Pop in whenever you want to see how things are evolving!

games.name: Pale Like Lilacs
games.description: Pale Like Lilacs is a short visual novel about an alcoholic vending machine whose only customer is a robot girl who loves beer. Talk with her, serve her drinks, and help each other survive a rapidly evolving dystopian city.

games.name: Saucer Rumble Showdown
games.description: Take control of your own flying saucer in this chaotic, physics-based arena party game! Ram opponents, dodge environmental hazards, and fight to be the last UFO flying. Battle in local multiplayer with CPU opponents or challenge players online!

games.name: Fast Point
games.description: A cozy cartoon co-op pickup point simulator. Receive parcels, serve customers, protect fragile cargo and perishable food, then grow a tiny pickup point into a full-blown logistics hub. Play solo or with friends.

games.name: RippleLoop
games.description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

games.name: Ooglie Booglies
games.description: A 2D shooter where chaos and fun are valued more than perfect skill and strategy. Get more powerful every round and unlock insane new abilities to beat your friends in hilarious and breathtaking ways.

games.name: Hot Pot Pizza Edition
games.description: Slice, bake, box and serve under pressure in a fast-paced first-person pizza game. Survive chaotic shifts, unlock kitchens and truck cosmetics, and go from a messy garage to your own restaurant.

games.name: Sweet Little Splash!
games.description: Draw lines, guide water and fill glasses in Sweet Little Splash! Solve physics puzzles with coloured streams, wind and mechanisms, meet anime heroines, choose dialogue replies and unlock illustrations.

games.name: PomoIdle Arena
games.description: A Pomodoro timer × idle × command-battle RPG. Resources build up while you work — pull commands, power up your party, and battle other players between sessions. Your focused time becomes your strength.

games.name: Myconaut
games.description: A puzzle platformer collectathon where secrets are hidden around every corner! Find your way through the vibrant undergrowth, while finding hidden seeds. Navigate the rich open-world with tight platformer controls and colourful graphics.

games.name: Proverbial
games.description: Hire a team of monkeys and start typing. It's time to find out if the old thought experiment is right. Given enough monkeys and upgrades can you find every word? Manage your monkeys, purchase upgrades, items, and abilities, and start filling your collections to become the best.

games.name: Blood Rails
games.description: An armored train, a straight track across a dead continent, and a horde that never stops chasing you. Turn your train into a fortress, loot abandoned villages and decide whether the next kilometer is worth the risk.

games.name: Odysseus' 13th Ship
games.description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

games.name: ScrapHeads
games.description: Smash it all and get paid! ScrapHeads is a chaotic co-op game for up to 4 players. Scrap spaceships, mechs, and anything else that lands in your yard with ridiculous tools, explosive mayhem, and wild physics. Feed Panzarius and turn every shift into a disaster!

games.name: Magic Castle: Tidy Up The Kingdom
games.description: Wield a magic wand and rebuild a scattered fairy-tale castle piece by piece in this cozy first-person game. Charm stones into place, sweep away rubble, earn upgrades and restore five enchanted halls, alone or in online co-op with up to 4 mages.

games.name: Wooden Tower
games.description: Pull wooden blocks from a teetering tower in a physics-based game of balance. Try the Daily Challenge, practice in Sandbox, face an AI opponent, or invite friends through Steam or Discord for online rounds with up to five players.

games.name: Mind the Tilt
games.description: Your house is balanced on a pin, and everything in it has weight. Do the jobs, keep it level, and don't be the one the game names for tipping it. A physics party game for 1 to 8 players, on one PC or online, across 29 houses that each tip in their own way.

games.name: They Seemed Normal
games.description: They Seemed Normal is a chaotic mix of inspection and tower defense where every stage affects the next. Work as a passport inspector and interrogate visitors. Let the right ones in and eliminate the "uncannies". Buy and upgrade birds, then use them as turrets to defend your base at night.

games.name: Flying Island Miner
games.description: Rise above the clouds and unearth the treasures of a floating island in this relaxing digging simulator. Dig through its layers, build a collection of curious finds, and unleash the full power of your tools. From your very first dig to the last grain of sand.

games.name: Idle Forgewarden
games.description: A cozy pixel-art blacksmith forge that lives on your desktop and keeps working while you do other things. Step in whenever you like to time the hammer, take commissions, arm adventurers for the road and grow a humble forge into a legendary smithy.
